---
title: "Exodus"
---

# Exodus

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Exodus recounts God's deliverance of Israel from slavery, the establishment of His covenant, and His presence among His people. The book teaches that God is a powerful Redeemer who rescues His people, calls them into covenant relationship, and desires faithful worship and obedience.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 1:8</div>

<div class="identifier">A new king arose</div>

### Why This Verse

Sets Israel's oppression in motion

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Israel's oppression in Egypt as their numbers increase. The key verse highlights God's blessing despite Pharaoh's attempts to suppress His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 2:24</div>

<div class="identifier">God remembered His covenant</div>

### Why This Verse

Turning point toward deliverance

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the birth, preservation, and early life of Moses. The key verse demonstrates God's providential preparation of Israel's future deliverer.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 3:14</div>

<div class="identifier">“I AM THAT I AM”</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most important divine self-revelations

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts God's appearance to Moses in the burning bush. The key verse reveals God's covenant name and eternal self-existence.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 4:12</div>

<div class="identifier">I will be with thy mouth</div>

### Why This Verse

God's assurance to Moses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter details God's commissioning of Moses despite his objections. The key verse assures Moses that God equips those He calls.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 5:2</div>

<div class="identifier">“Who is the LORD?”</div>

### Why This Verse

Pharaoh's defining challenge

### Chapter Insight

This chapter begins Moses' confrontation with Pharaoh. The key verse captures Pharaoh's rejection of God's authority.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 6:7</div>

<div class="identifier">I will take you to be My people</div>

### Why This Verse

Covenant redemption promise

### Chapter Insight

This chapter reaffirms God's covenant promises to Israel. The key verse emphasizes God's commitment to redeem His people from bondage.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 7:5</div>

<div class="identifier">Egyptians shall know I am the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Purpose of the plagues

### Chapter Insight

This chapter introduces the plagues through Moses and Aaron's confrontation with Pharaoh. The key verse reveals God's purpose of making Himself known.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 8:23</div>

<div class="identifier">I will put a division between My people and thy people</div>

### Why This Verse

Divine distinction emphasized

### Chapter Insight

This chapter continues the plagues and demonstrates God's power over Egypt's gods. The key verse highlights Pharaoh's temporary repentance without true submission.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 9:16</div>

<div class="identifier">Raised up to show My power</div>

### Why This Verse

Frequently cited by Paul (Romans 9)

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records additional plagues and Pharaoh's continued hardness of heart. The key verse explains God's purpose in displaying His power throughout the earth.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 10:2</div>

<div class="identifier">Tell your son and grandson</div>

### Why This Verse

Importance of remembering God's acts

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes the plagues of locusts and darkness. The key verse emphasizes God's sovereignty in accomplishing His purposes.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 11:7</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD puts a difference</div>

### Why This Verse

Final plague preview

### Chapter Insight

This chapter announces the final plague against Egypt. The key verse prepares for God's decisive act of deliverance.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 12:13</div>

<div class="identifier">When I see the blood</div>

### Why This Verse

Central Passover verse

### Chapter Insight

This chapter institutes the Passover and records Israel's deliverance. The key verse establishes the Passover as a lasting memorial of redemption.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 13:9</div>

<div class="identifier">Memorial upon thy hand</div>

### Why This Verse

Foundation for remembrance traditions

### Chapter Insight

This chapter focuses on consecration and God's guidance after the Exodus. The key verse emphasizes remembering God's mighty deliverance.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 14:14</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD shall fight for you</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Exodus' best-known promises

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Israel's crossing of the Red Sea. The key verse calls God's people to trust Him while He fights on their behalf.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 15

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 15:2</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD is my strength and song</div>

### Why This Verse

Classic song of deliverance

### Chapter Insight

This chapter celebrates God's victory through the Song of Moses. The key verse declares God's unmatched greatness and power.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 16

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 16:4</div>

<div class="identifier">Bread from heaven</div>

### Why This Verse

Manna narrative centerpiece

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts God's provision of manna in the wilderness. The key verse teaches dependence upon God's daily provision.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 17

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 17:15</div>

<div class="identifier">Jehovah-nissi</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous divine title

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records water from the rock and victory over Amalek. The key verse highlights God's presence and faithfulness among His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 18

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 18:21</div>

<div class="identifier">Able men over thousands</div>

### Why This Verse

Classic leadership/delegation model

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Jethro's counsel regarding leadership. The key verse emphasizes wise delegation and shared responsibility.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 19

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 19:5</div>

<div class="identifier">A treasured possession</div>

### Why This Verse

Israel's covenant identity

### Chapter Insight

This chapter prepares Israel to meet God at Mount Sinai. The key verse reveals God's desire for Israel to be His holy nation.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 20

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 20:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Thou shalt have no other gods</div>

### Why This Verse

Beginning of the Ten Commandments

### Chapter Insight

This chapter gives the Ten Commandments. The key verse summarizes God's covenant authority as the basis for His commandments.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 21

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 21:24</div>

<div class="identifier">Eye for eye</div>

### Why This Verse

Most quoted law in the chapter

### Chapter Insight

This chapter provides laws governing justice and relationships. The key verse reflects God's concern for fairness and accountability.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 22

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 22:21</div>

<div class="identifier">Do not oppress a stranger</div>

### Why This Verse

Foundational social justice text

### Chapter Insight

This chapter continues covenant laws concerning property and social responsibility. The key verse emphasizes compassion and justice toward others.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 23

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 23:20</div>

<div class="identifier">I send an Angel before thee</div>

### Why This Verse

Guidance and protection promise

### Chapter Insight

This chapter outlines additional laws and covenant blessings. The key verse promises God's guidance and protection through obedience.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 24

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 24:7</div>

<div class="identifier">All that the LORD hath spoken we will do</div>

### Why This Verse

Covenant ratification

### Chapter Insight

This chapter formally confirms the covenant between God and Israel. The key verse expresses Israel's commitment to obey God's commands.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 25

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 25:8</div>

<div class="identifier">Let them make Me a sanctuary</div>

### Why This Verse

Purpose of the tabernacle

### Chapter Insight

This chapter begins instructions for building the Tabernacle. The key verse reveals God's desire to dwell among His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 26

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 26:33</div>

<div class="identifier">The veil shall separate</div>

### Why This Verse

Key tabernacle symbolism

### Chapter Insight

This chapter details the structure of the Tabernacle. The key verse emphasizes the holiness and order of God's dwelling place.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 27

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 27:20</div>

<div class="identifier">Pure oil for the lamp</div>

### Why This Verse

Worship continuity

### Chapter Insight

This chapter gives instructions for the altar and courtyard. The key verse focuses on worship and access to God's presence.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 28

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 28:36</div>

<div class="identifier">HOLINESS TO THE LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Priesthood's defining inscription

### Chapter Insight

This chapter establishes the priesthood and sacred garments. The key verse highlights the priest's role in representing God's people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 29

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 29:45</div>

<div class="identifier">I will dwell among Israel</div>

### Why This Verse

Goal of priestly ministry

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes the consecration of the priests. The key verse emphasizes God's intention to dwell among Israel through worship.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 30

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 30:10</div>

<div class="identifier">Atonement once a year</div>

### Why This Verse

Day of Atonement connection

### Chapter Insight

This chapter provides instructions for worship furnishings and offerings. The key verse stresses holiness in approaching God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 31

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 31:13</div>

<div class="identifier">My Sabbaths you shall keep</div>

### Why This Verse

Sabbath as covenant sign

### Chapter Insight

This chapter appoints craftsmen and reinforces the Sabbath. The key verse shows that God equips individuals for His work.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 32

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 32:32</div>

<div class="identifier">Blot me out of Your book</div>

### Why This Verse

Moses' intercession

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Israel's sin with the golden calf. The key verse reveals the seriousness of idolatry and covenant unfaithfulness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 33

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 33:14</div>

<div class="identifier">My presence shall go with thee</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous promise of God's presence

### Chapter Insight

This chapter highlights Moses' intercession and desire for God's presence. The key verse expresses the necessity of God's presence among His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 34

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 34:6</div>

<div class="identifier">Merciful and gracious, longsuffering</div>

### Why This Verse

Most repeated divine description in Scripture

### Chapter Insight

This chapter renews the covenant after Israel's sin. The key verse reveals God's character as merciful, gracious, and forgiving.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 35

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 35:21</div>

<div class="identifier">Everyone whose heart stirred him</div>

### Why This Verse

Voluntary worship giving

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Israel's response in contributing to the Tabernacle. The key verse highlights willing hearts devoted to God's work.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 36

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 36:6</div>

<div class="identifier">The people bring much more than enough</div>

### Why This Verse

Notable generosity passage

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes the construction of the Tabernacle. The key verse demonstrates the people's generosity and obedience.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 37

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 37:1</div>

<div class="identifier">Bezalel made the ark</div>

### Why This Verse

Ark construction highlight

### Chapter Insight

This chapter details the making of the Tabernacle furnishings. The key verse reflects careful obedience to God's instructions.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 38

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 38:8</div>

<div class="identifier">Laver made from mirrors</div>

### Why This Verse

Most memorable detail

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records completion of the courtyard and sacred objects. The key verse emphasizes accountability and stewardship in God's work.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 39

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 39:43</div>

<div class="identifier">Moses blessed them</div>

### Why This Verse

Completion of the work

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes the completion of the priestly garments and Tabernacle items. The key verse highlights Israel's obedience to God's commands.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 40

<div class="key-verse">Exodus 40:34</div>

<div class="identifier">Glory filled the tabernacle</div>

### Why This Verse

Climactic conclusion of Exodus

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the erection of the Tabernacle and God's glory filling it. The key verse marks the fulfillment of God's promise to dwell among His people.
:::
